RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel at a public broadcaster is a potential governance concern, as many public institutions require diverse hiring panels to mitigate unconscious bias. It may suggest institutional oversight or systemic bias, but it does not definitively prove sex discrimination.

The successful candidate's digital media background may reflect legitimate strategic priorities, even with fewer years in news. Furthermore, differences in interview performance could explain the outcome.

Before making formal allegations, follow up on your feedback request and consult internal HR policies or your union regarding panel composition rules. Frame any initial inquiry around institutional recruitment standards and role criteria rather than direct accusations, unless concrete evidence of bias emerges.
